UPSO.source: Exploratory sensitivity hypothesis: c1=w_min=0.6, c2=w_max=0.9, and omega=0.3; not source-verified SOG parameters

notes: Exploratory UPSO parameter-mapping hypothesis only; do not describe this profile as an exact SOG reproduction.
Relative to budget_matched_300s.json, only the UPSO inertia, c1, and c2 differ.
All algorithms use a shared cap of 15000 physical objective evaluations and a 300-second wall-clock limit per run.
If either limit is reached, the optimizer returns the best point evaluated so far.
A physical objective call already in progress is allowed to finish before the wall-clock limit stops it.
GIVP cache hits do not consume the physical-evaluation budget.
